children: Laredo Oil signed a non-binding LOI with an established Argentine oil operator to evaluate commercial deployment of its UGD technology. Any project is subject to FEED, due diligence, financing, regulatory approvals, and definitive agreements.
Opens a path to first commercial UGD deployment, a potential revenue driver if executed.
Reduces competitive risk during diligence and negotiations.
Financing need is a key execution risk for a micro-cap issuer.
Aligns returns to realized production; payback hinges on uplift and oil prices.
Multiple contingencies; timeline and certainty remain unclear.
This is an early-stage step toward monetizing UGD, with no definitive deal or funding secured. A signed production sharing agreement and financing would convert this into a near-term catalyst.
